narrative.overview: The design system embodies the gravitas, structural precision, and calm discipline of an international real estate investment monograph. Rather than resembling a high-churn SaaS landing page or a decorative portfolio template, every surface conveys the enduring weight of monumental physical construction and corporate stewardship. It pairs the architectural authority of structural civil engineering with the refined composure of a board-level executive suite. The system alternates deliberately between high-contrast Deep Midnight Navy grounds and Warm Alabaster/Ivory editorial canvases. Muted Champagne Gold is deployed with surgical discipline as an executive seal of credibility and active focus, never as wanton decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Monographic Discipline: Editorial typography pairing classical high-contrast serif headlines with razor-sharp technical sans-serif body copy.
Architectural Framing: Subtle hairline borders, structural grid alignments, and tonal dark containment in place of loud gradients or floating cards.
Prestige Restraint: Champagne Gold is strictly capped at <=10% visual surface area to maintain its status as an authentic hallmark of prestige.
Verifiable Truth Focus: Layouts foreground concrete metrics, certified affiliations (BUET, PMP, NSU), and documented high-rise delivery without frivolous embellishment.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Gold Rule
rules.body: Muted Champagne Gold must never exceed 10% of any viewport's surface area. Its rarity is what gives it prestige and focus; overuse degrades executive gravitas into commercial clutter.

rules.name: The Ground Inversion Rule
rules.body: Transitions between Midnight Navy and Warm Ivory mark structural chapter changes in the narrative. When inverting grounds, text and borders immediately invert their contrast roles without introducing intermediate pastel shades.

rules.name: The Structural Editorial Rule
rules.body: Serif typography (Playfair Display) is strictly reserved for primary headlines, section titles, and highlighted pull-quotes. All body copy, numerical data, navigation labels, and UI controls must be set in clean sans-serif (Inter).

rules.name: The Hairline Structure Rule
rules.body: Surface boundaries must be defined primarily by 1px hairline borders rather than fuzzy drop shadows. Shadows serve only as ambient grounding, never as edge definitions.

dos: Do maintain the 10% limit on Muted Champagne Gold across all pages and components.
Do preserve 1px hairline borders to establish crisp architectural boundaries.
Do pair Playfair Display for editorial headlines with Inter for all body and tabular data.
Do ensure all interactive buttons and inputs meet the 44px minimum touch target height.
Do use authentic project photographs and verified metrics directly from content source of truth.
donts: Don't use multi-color rainbow badges, bright neon accents, or unconstrained gradients.
Don't use arbitrary percentage bars (e.g. 'AutoCAD 90%') to describe competencies; express capabilities through verified projects and achievements.
Don't apply Playfair Display to buttons, navigation menus, labels, or multi-paragraph body text.
Don't use bubbly rounded card radii (>16px) or heavy cartoonish drop shadows.
Don't invent speculative claims, fictional corporate partnerships, or unverified project sizes.
